claims.claim: A shared queue can deterministically arbitrate promoted physical attack, spell completion, and periodic effect actions at one world tick.
support: existing physical turn scheduler emits stable sequences
effect lifecycle emits exact tick timestamps
assumptions: fixture priorities are not asserted as original MajorMUD production constants
claims.fallback: reject production policies whose priority remains unresolved
claims.runtime_impact: enables one auditable claim boundary for cross-subsystem actions
claims.character_save_impact: none; queued native-temporary actions are not promoted as persisted state
claims.world_state_impact: mutations occur only after a claimed action is executed by its owning runtime
